device.description: 14-bit 50-200 kSPS pseudo-differential SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial output (automotive)
device.note: adc141s628-q1.pdf (SNOI146C) p.4 (pin configuration and functions), p.5 (recommended operating conditions: VA, VIO 4.5-5.5 V), p.7 (output coding straight binary), p.8 (timing: tEN 51, tDA 40, tDIS 20 ns max), p.17 (serial interface, data output)

pages: p.4 (pin configuration and functions), p.5 (recommended operating conditions: VA, VIO 4.5-5.5 V), p.7 (output coding straight binary), p.8 (timing: tEN 51, tDA 40, tDIS 20 ns max), p.17 (serial interface, data output)
notModeled: analog input and reference (pseudo-differential input (-IN at GND), straight binary output (0 V reads 0x0000))
conversion is clocked by SCLK (15 SCLK conversion, then acquisition after the 16th falling edge): the result is the 0 V code at once
DOUT after the LSB: the datasheet shows DB0 held until CS rises; modeled as 0 (the LSB of the 0 V code is 0)
SCLK frequency limits (minimum 0.9 MHz from capacitor leakage), throughput and CS-setup window; a frame aborted by CS rising before the 16th falling edge
data is output on SCLK falling edges with SCLK idling high or low (CS falling with SCLK low counts as the first falling edge); modeled as SPI mode 3
variants: ADC141S628-Q1 (automotive); same pinout and frame as ADC141S626 but straight binary and a 4.5-5.5 V supply range
